data.name: Mammoth Cave Visitor Center
data.description: The park visitor center is the central point for visitors to orient themselves to what lies both above and below the surface at Mammoth Cave. Situated just up the hill from the cave's Historic Entrance, the visitor center is the departure point for all cave tours, and offers exhibits to prepare you for discovery. You can also meet a ranger for a talk or a hike. Gifts, restrooms, permits and information are available and visitor amenities are offered by the nearby Lodge at Mammoth Cave across the footbridge.
data.audioDescription: The visitor center is a large stone building located up a hill from the main cave entrance and behind the lodge. In front of the visitor center is an outdoor open are shelter with cave tour information. Entering the front doors for the building, restrooms are located to the left of the entrance. Continuing around the main lobby clockwise is the cave tour ticket sales area, exit doors to the cave tour departure area, a gift sales area, and exit doors leading to the lodge. Directly in front of the main entrance doors and centrally located in the main visitor center lobby is a visitor information desk. Counterclockwise to the right of the main entrance doors is the park bookstore, followed by the entrance to the visitor center exhibit area. The exhibit area is a loop hallway, with interactive exhibits and audio visual presentations.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: The Mammoth Cave Passport Stamp is located in the America's National Parks bookstore. The passport stamp is the NPS Classic Passport Cancellation Stamp consisting of a circle, park name and date.

data.directionsInfo: From the North: Take Interstate 65 to Exit 53 (Cave City Exit). Turn right onto KY-70. Follow 70/255 as it becomes the Mammoth Cave Parkway in the park. Follow the Mammoth Cave Parkway to the Visitor Center. From the South: Take Interstate 65 to Exit 48 (Park City Exit). Turn left onto KY-255 and follow 255 as it becomes the Park City Road into the park. Follow Park City Road until it joins the Mammoth Cave Parkway; turn left. Follow the Mammoth Cave Parkway to the Visitor Center.

operatingHours.description: Hours for the Mammoth Cave National Park Visitor Center vary by season, with expanded hours during the peak summer season from Memorial Day to Labor Day.
